name: Knife Hit
description: Throw knives into a spinning log without hitting the others.

description_i18n.en: Throw knives at a spinning log without hitting the other knives.

prompt: A one-tap game like Knife Hit: throw knives into a spinning wooden log, do not hit knives already stuck in it, apples to slice for points, a boss log every 5 stages with changing rotation speed and direction, splinter particles. Make it addictive and viral: a daily challenge, streak or progress that brings people back every day, very satisfying animations, haptics with Acornix.vibrate and sounds made with Web Audio, records saved with Acornix.db, and a Share button that draws a beautiful result
author: gonzaroman
